# Owino FairShare — Smart Expense Splitting & Debt Minimization SaaS
> 100% Free, Privacy-First, Open-Architecture Expense Ledger with Real-Time Greedy Debt Minimization and Dynamic UPI 2.0 Settlement QR Codes.

## Overview
Owino (FairShare) is a modern cloud-native FinTech web platform designed to eliminate multi-party expense friction for roommates, travel groups, event organizers, and distributed teams.

## Key Capabilities & Differentiators
- **Greedy Debt Minimization Algorithm (DAG)**: Reduces bilateral debt networks by up to 70-90% mathematically, ensuring net conservation (`sum(netBalances) === 0`).
- **Dynamic UPI 2.0 Payment QR Codes**: Instant on-device mobile settlement via PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm, or BHIM with pre-filled amounts and payee VPA.
- **1-Click Splitwise Migration**: High-speed idempotent CSV migration tool importing 2,200+ historical expenses and multi-party group structures in seconds with zero data loss.
- **Itemized Bill & Restaurant Splitter**: Dedicated mobile-first splitter calculating GST tax, tips, and custom line-item member assignments.
- **Zero Paywalls & No Ads**: Unlike Splitwise, FairShare imposes zero daily expense creation limits, zero delays on transaction logging, and zero advertisement banners.
- **Full Accountability Audit Trail**: Exact field-level diff tracking (`from` vs `to`) recording who created, updated, or deleted any transaction with pre-deletion state recovery snapshots.
